imputer_params.knn: sklearn KNNImputer(n_neighbors=10, metric='nan_euclidean', weights='uniform'), fitted on the 24-h window itself (retrospective, uses rows on both sides of the gap), covariates in native units (no standardization); a standardized variant is benchmarked alongside
imputer_params.iterative: sklearn IterativeImputer(estimator=BayesianRidge(), max_iter=10, tol=1e-3, initial_strategy='mean', imputation_order='ascending', random_state=42), fitted on the 24-h window itself
imputer_params.profile: minute-of-day mean of the training windows (31-min smoothed), anchored by the mean offset between observed samples of the window and the profile
imputer_params.hybrid: linear for gaps <= 60 min, anchored profile otherwise
imputer_params.covariates: humidity, temperature, soil moisture, light (co-recorded healthy channels)
imputer_params.fitting_scope: all imputers are fitted per 24-h held-out window; they may use observations after the gap (retrospective repair, as stated in Section 3.5)
